AccountLinkIntent.description: A short-lived server-issued intent to link a guest to a registered identity.
AccountLinkIntent.title: AccountLinkIntent

AskCheckRequest.description: The user's message, read once for a home/work reference. Never stored or logged.
AskCheckRequest.title: AskCheckRequest

AskStateView.description:
``recorded`` is False when the server stored nothing (no SAVED_PLACE consent): the client
keeps the ask-state on the device, as a guest does.
AskStateView.title: AskStateView

ConsentRecord.description: Append-only ledger entry; storage and the withdrawal cascade are out of scope here.
ConsentRecord.title: ConsentRecord

ConsentView.description: An active consent as the client sees it (never a coordinate; withdrawn ones are not listed).
ConsentView.title: ConsentView

DiscoveryBlock.description:
Google's grounded answer, verbatim: the raw summary text, then every place's attribution
in order. ``render_mode`` "text" means a client inserts each field with textContent, never as
HTML or Markdown. The server framing sits OUTSIDE this block (``TurnResponse.reply``).
DiscoveryBlock.title: DiscoveryBlock

DiscoveryPlace.description: One source, exactly as Google provided it (shown as text, linked to its urls).
DiscoveryPlace.title: DiscoveryPlace

ErrorReason.description:
Stable machine-readable refinement of an ``ErrorCode``. Clients switch on this, never on
the message. Additive: a client must treat an unknown reason like its ``ErrorCode``.
ErrorReason.title: ErrorReason

ExportBundle.description:
Everything the server holds about the caller: user data and place IDs only. Never Maps
content, a token, an idempotency key or a coordinate other than a saved place's rounded one.
ExportBundle.title: ExportBundle

FactEdit.description: A user edit. The server stamps source USER_EXPLICIT and CONFIRMED; the client cannot.
FactEdit.title: FactEdit

FramingKind.description:
Fixed server copy shown above a grounded block, selected by enum: free text can never be
framing. Lives here (not in discovery.render, which re-exports it) so the API contract can
name it.
FramingKind.title: FramingKind

HistoryRecordCreate.description: Only user-chosen references; the server derives owner, time, daypart, retention, consent.
HistoryRecordCreate.title: HistoryRecordCreate

HistoryRecordEdit.description: The user's edit of their own record: label, activity tag and feedback only.
HistoryRecordEdit.title: HistoryRecordEdit

HistorySettingsUpdate.description: Shortening purges what is already past the new period, immediately.
HistorySettingsUpdate.title: HistorySettingsUpdate

IntentTag.description: Classified from the user's own request, never from Maps content.
IntentTag.title: IntentTag

LocationInput.description: ``{latitude, longitude}`` and nothing else (no accuracy, altitude or timestamp).
LocationInput.title: LocationInput

OutcomeCheckin.description: The user's own report after an outing. The note is free text: excluded from telemetry.
OutcomeCheckin.title: OutcomeCheckin

OutingStrength.description: A handoff is not proof of a visit.
OutingStrength.title: OutingStrength

PendingAction.description:
Two-step side effect: shown as ``preview``, committed only on explicit confirmation.

Confirmation produces a new copy via ``confirm_pending_action``; the field is never
assigned. The lifetime ceiling is MAX_PENDING_ACTION_TTL (owner decision, 15 minutes).
PendingAction.title: PendingAction

PlaceCard.description: Server-rendered Places Details view model (minimal field mask). Display-only, never stored.
PlaceCard.title: PlaceCard

PlanWarning.description: Warnings are codes, never free text, so provider content cannot ride in them.
PlanWarning.title: PlanWarning

ReminderItem.description: A confirmed in-app reminder: stored LOCALLY by the client, shown on next open.
ReminderItem.title: ReminderItem

RoundedPosition.description: A user-confirmed position rounded to ~100 m on parse; redacted from repr and errors.
RoundedPosition.title: RoundedPosition

RouteCheck.description: Server-rendered Routes view model: duration and distance only. No geometry, no origin.
RouteCheck.title: RouteCheck

SavedPlace.description:
User data only (decision 24): a place ID, the label the user typed and a rounded position.

``kind`` is the schema discriminator, so HOME/WORK/CUSTOM is ``label_kind``.
SavedPlace.title: SavedPlace

SavedPlacePrompt.description: Tells the client to show a FIXED question. ``question`` is server text, never model text.
SavedPlacePrompt.title: SavedPlacePrompt

TurnWarning.description: Typed, content-free warnings on a partial result.
TurnWarning.title: TurnWarning

WorkspaceView.description: The caller's workspace as the client may see it: no owner, no evidence.
WorkspaceView.title: WorkspaceView

post.description:
``Idempotency-Key`` is optional: when sent it must be the action's own key (a retry repeats
the same key and nonce and gets the same typed result).

delete.description: Clear all of the caller's history.

post.description: The user's explicit save of an outing (idempotent by ``Idempotency-Key``).

put.description: Choose 30 to 180 days. Shortening purges what is already past the new period, at once.

post.description:
Stored server-side only for a REGISTERED principal with history active and consent; for a
guest nothing durable is written and ``recorded`` is False (keep it on the device).

delete.description: One saved place (``place_id``) or, without it, all of them.

put.description:
Edit the label of an EXISTING saved place. Creating or moving one needs a confirmed
SAVE_PLACE action, so an unknown place ID is a 404 and a different kind or position a 422.

post.description:
Whether to show the FIXED "Is where you are now your home? Save it as Home?" question for
this message. The text is server-authored; the message is neither stored nor logged.

put.description:
Record a decline (30-day cooldown), "don't ask again", or clear them. ``recorded`` is False
when the server stored nothing (no SAVED_PLACE consent): the client keeps it on the device.

post.description:
Counts the workspace's trip once. At the trip limit the answer is a 200 whose usage meter
is GATED with ``gate_reason`` TRIPS_LIMIT (the typed gate); the workspace is not counted.
